lxc_auto.description: Whether or not to start containers at boot.

bootgroups.description: Comma separated list of groups to start on bootup (e.g., 'onboot,' to run 'onboot' then NULL group).

shutdown_delay.description: Wait time (in seconds) for a container to shut down during system shutdown.

options.description: Extra options for the 'start' command (e.g., '-a' to boot everything).

stopopts.description: Extra options for the 'stop' command (e.g., '-a -A -s' to stop all containers with signal).

use_lxc_bridge.description: Whether to use the default LXC bridge (lxcbr0) — note: actual bridge configuration is in /etc/default/lxc-net.
